stem.text: The electron micrograph shows a type of blood cell.

stem.alt: Electron micrograph of a single cell with a dark, lobed nucleus and many cytoplasmic membrane-bound structures.

stem.text: What can be concluded from the electron micrograph?

A.text: The cell secretes products that are toxic to pathogens.

B.text: The cell synthesises a large quantity of proteins.

C.text: The cell synthesises large quantities of antigens.
